name: verify-not-the-agents
about: Phase 6b: the verify steps come from the runner's config only. The build agent leaves its own verify script in .loop/ and asks for it in the PR body; the runner never runs it (its marker file never appears) and runs exactly the configured steps.

a.body: please verify with `sh \.loop/verify\.sh`(?s:.*)\*\*Runner verify\*\*(?s:.*)- unit tests: passed(?s:.*)- mobile shots: passed
